children: Italy plans to confirm its commitment to bring its deficit-to-GDP ratio below the European Union's 3% ceiling in 2026 from 3.1% in 2025, sources said, as the government finalises a new budget plan due in the next few weeks.
The government sees this year's deficit to come in broadly in line with the 2.9% goal announced in April, the sources added.
